import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_30/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_30/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source5_30_0 and Source5_30_1 on 'school_name'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by ['Student ID', 'school_name'] and aggregate:
# sum of budget from Source5_30_0 (df0), average of math_score and reading_score from Source5_30_1 (df1)
agg_df = df_joined.groupby(['Student ID', 'school_name'], as_index=False).agg({
    'budget': 'sum',
    'math_score': 'mean',
    'reading_score': 'mean'
})

# Reorder columns and cast types to match target schema:
# ['school_name': string, 'Student ID': integer, 'budget': integer, 'math_score': float, 'reading_score': float]

# Ensure correct types
agg_df['school_name'] = agg_df['school_name'].astype(str)
agg_df['Student ID'] = agg_df['Student ID'].astype(int)
agg_df['budget'] = agg_df['budget'].round().astype(int)
agg_df['math_score'] = agg_df['math_score'].astype(float)
agg_df['reading_score'] = agg_df['reading_score'].astype(float)

# Reorder columns as per target schema
Target5_30 = agg_df[['school_name', 'Student ID', 'budget', 'math_score', 'reading_score']]

# Save to the target path
Target5_30.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (inner join to keep only matching schools)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='school_name')

# Group by school_name (the primary key in target)
# Aggregations:
# - Student ID: max (to get a single representative ID per school)
# - budget: max (budget is constant per school in source0, max or sum would be same, max safer)
# - math_score: average
# - reading_score: average
agg = joined.groupby('school_name').agg({
    'Student ID': 'max',
    'budget': 'max',
    'math_score': 'mean',
    'reading_score': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
agg = agg[['school_name', 'Student ID', 'budget', 'math_score', 'reading_score']]

# Write output
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_30/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
